sources.title: Among the Firsts: Lieutenant Colonel Gerhard L. Bolland's Unconventional War
sources.locator: Pages 106-107; the 99th Infantry Battalion selection for OSS training and the roster entry for Pfc. Olaf H. Aanonsen
sources.rights_notes: Published scholarly history; only short excerpts are retained. A one-digit identifier disagreement in the accessible transcription is not reproduced publicly.

organizations.normalization_notes: Modeled as a specific historical U.S. Army battalion; not merged into OSS or the later 474th Infantry Regiment.

affiliations.date_precision: selected from the 99th Infantry Battalion for OSS training; exact transfer date not established
affiliations.research_notes: The Denver Public Library index supplies an exact private identifier match and Company C, 99th Infantry assignment. Bolland places Aanonsen on the roster selected from the battalion for OSS training. DPL lists PVT, Bolland lists Pfc., and the NARA index lists Cpl.; the public role therefore remains rank-neutral.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Olaf H. Aanonsen is strongly matched to the Company C, 99th Infantry soldier selected for OSS training.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Denver Public Library index matches the exact private identifier and full name, while Bolland independently names Olaf H. Aanonsen on the battalion's OSS-selection roster.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact full name, exact private identifier, compatible enlisted ranks, 99th Infantry assignment, and independent published OSS-selection roster.
claims.temporal_assessment: The published chronology places the selection while the battalion trained at Camp Hale and before the selected men went to Washington for OSS training.
claims.match_notes: The accessible book transcription disagrees by one digit with the exact identifier shared by NARA and DPL. The identifier is withheld publicly; the discrepancy remains noted for archival review.

sources.excerpt_override: Aanonsen, Olaf H. … PVT … C … 99TH INF

claims.claim_text: Aanonsen's immediate pre-OSS affiliation was Company C, 99th Infantry Battalion (Separate).
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Bolland describes OSS interviews within the battalion at Camp Hale, names Aanonsen among the final selections, and says the selected men went to Washington for OSS training.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The DPL exact private identifier and full-name match resolve the roster entry to the indexed person despite a transcription discrepancy in the book.
claims.temporal_assessment: The recruitment sequence explicitly places the 99th Infantry assignment immediately before OSS training.
claims.match_notes: The sources disagree on enlisted grade, so the affiliation uses a rank-neutral role and preserves the discrepancy in research notes.
